description: UN/LOCODE-oppføringer i Norge klassifisert som «Road transport». All 626 Norwegian UN/LOCODE entries whose function mask marks them as road transport, per the UNECE function-classifiers table shipped with the source. Facet, not a partition: a location carrying several functions appears in several of these lists. Fields: LOCODE, place name, subdivision, all function classifiers, approval status, IATA code and coordinates.

Facet, not a partition: a location carrying several functions appears in several of these lists.
